envelope.description: Verify installed behavior and publish honest handoff

body.title: Verify installed behavior and publish honest handoff
body.summary: Update operator docs, run affected regression suites and build, then after deployment run one explicitly authorized serial pair per selected mode. Record actual startup/canary/checkpoint/cancel results and residual unsupported checks with truthful accounting. Run the mandatory final Story code review once, with no automatic repeated rounds; activation signoff remains separate.
acceptanceChecks: Affected focused regressions and build pass; ordinary/native/Codex compatibility checked within changed boundary.
Installed verification binds exact deployment and both modes, with one control/restricted pair each and no automatic retry; pending deployment is not reported as executed.
Report and runbook distinguish verified facts, controls, missing evidence and activation. Unsupported is an honest diagnostic outcome, never a qualification/activation pass; unknown usage stays null.

tests.name: Serial bounded installed control and restricted attempts record startup inventory and canary results honestly for both modes
Runbook distinguishes verified capabilities diagnostic controls unsupported facts and separate activation signoff
Affected native and ordinary provider regressions and build pass
